mechanism_interpretation.changed_credit_changes_parameters: Measured whole-model and Memory PG rotation demonstrates a parameter-level difference, beyond comparing scalar advantages. Magnitude incorporates both credit definition and its actual normalization.
mechanism_interpretation.safe_EP_conflict: All3 Memory safe/EP cosines are negative. Shared parameters couple otherwise candidate-local feasibility and within-feasible efficiency preferences; this is partial gradient cancellation, not proof EP is unsafe or should be removed.
mechanism_interpretation.anchor: Weighted anchor norm is15.2–25.9% of Safety whole-model PG here; its alignment varies. These observations reject a blanket anchor-dominates explanation for this bounded window, not all training.
mechanism_interpretation.Comfort: The two EP1/strict-feasible groups still have Comfort0/1 and PDMS5/6 versus1. Current Safety ignores that distinction and has measured zero PG; canonical PPO has nonzero action/Memory gradients. Anchor remains, with unknown effect on Comfort.
mechanism_interpretation.no_clip_explanation: All current/old logp are bit-identical, no A-cap hits or actual PPO blocked candidate-steps; this run isolates first-inner credit differences and cannot settle later-inner clipping pathology.
